rows.label: tev036601_MSG0001
rows.name:
Mee-mee has worked with minerals from
many planets while traveling aboard the
Ma-non ship![ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0002
rows.name:
But I've never seen anything as special
as Miranium![ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0003
rows.name:
Depending on how you process it, it can
be harder than iron or softer than a
sponge![ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0004
rows.name:
And if you split its molecules just
right, you might even be able to extract
energy![ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0005
rows.name:
Such a versatile mineral lying around
everywhere... Planet Mira is truly
amazing![ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0008
rows.name:
Mee-mee is developing a super machine
that converts Miranium into all kinds of
materials![ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0009
rows.name:
When it's finished, I'll need lots and
lots of Miranium![ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0010
rows.name:
Please sell me lots! My company, the
Shining Erudition Hall, will post
requests at the Quest Board![ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0025
rows.name:
Thanks for your patronage! Welcome to
the Shining Erudition Hall![ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0026
rows.name:
My super alchemy machine is finally
finished! The Miranium Change![ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0027
rows.name:
We're buying Miranium through the Quest
Board right now! Please make use of our
service![ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0028
rows.name:
We'll start a special member service
soon, too! I hope you'll use that as
well, please![ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_SEL1021
rows.name: Ask how things have been lately.[ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0029
rows.name:
Welcome, dear bronze member! Mee-mee's
business is booming![ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0030
rows.name:
How about you? Your rate went up! Have
you been cashing in Miranium?[ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0031
rows.name:
You can take the request any time at the
Quest Board, so keep cashing in![ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0032
rows.name:
And soon you'll have a chance to move up
to silver member, so look forward to
that, too![ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_SEL2021
rows.name: Ask how things have been lately.[ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0033
rows.name:
Welcome, dear silver member! Thanks to
you, the Miranium Change super alchemy
machine is in top form![ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0034
rows.name:
We're offering members only a super
exchange rate right now![ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0035
rows.name: Let's cash in and get lots of money![ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_SEL3021
rows.name: Ask how things have been lately.[ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0036
rows.name:
Wow! Dear gold member! Welcome to the
Shining Erudition Hall![ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0037
rows.name:
Thanks to you, Mee-mee's assets are
soaring![ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0038
rows.name:
At this rate, the day I become NLA's
richest person is very, very near![ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0039
rows.name:
We're offering a special high exchange
rate just for you! Cash in at the Quest
Board![ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_SEL4021
rows.name: Ask how things have been lately.[ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0040
rows.name:
When I went to donate Mee-mee's money to
BLADE...[ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0041
rows.name:
I talked about Miranium with a cool
researcher called Kirsty![ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0042
rows.name:
That special mineral can be found in
every area of planet Mira, right?[ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0043
rows.name:
It's unnatural however you look at it.
As if the planet itself was made to
generate Miranium on purpose...[ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0044
rows.name:
Kirsty said something like, maybe God
gave it to us as a present...[ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0045
rows.name:
What is God, anyway? Some incredibly
skilled engineer?[ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0048
rows.name:
Nice pizza, dear platinum member! Been
eating Grenade Pizza?[ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0049
rows.name:
Mee-mee spends every day eating pizza
and is very, very happy![ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0050
rows.name:
I don't have the slightest interest in
money or the Shining Erudition Hall
anymore, though![ST:wait ]

rows.label: tev036601_MSG0051
rows.name:
Your special high-rate exchange service
is still running, regardless of profit!
Keep using it![ST:wait ]
